title: The nest goes down when 'at the nest' has depth
question: Which of these reads as a nest being dug, rather than the floor being scratched?
context_md: Same colony, same box, same 6,000 frames. One arm counts an ant as 'at home' only in the top row or two; the other, 40 rows down. COUNTS, seed 2 of 12: digs 2,872 -> 5,564; cells of room 709 -> 1,002; room depth 18 -> 37 rows; height over width 0.11 -> 0.20. Over 12 paired seeds: room 1.44x, bigger on 12 of 12; height-over-width 1.81x, taller on 11 of 12.
